div.div: CI only proves the code runs; the manual workflow is where settings are decided; the weekly step watches the live index for drift. Mined questions are added only after a person labels them, so the set is never tuned to a retriever.

text.tspan: CI only proves the code runs; the manual workflow is where settings are decided; the weekly step watches the live index for drift. Mined questions are added only after a person labels them,
so the set is never tuned to a retriever.
